summary.text: Veronica Garcia-Martinez is the Democratic candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 70 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Jeff Keicher (R).
Garcia-Martinez is a fifth-grade dual-language teacher and former small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Garcia-Martinez graduated from West Aurora High School and earned a graduate degree from Northern Illinois University in 2024.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a mother of three, has lived in DeKalb County since 2010 and previously owned Tinez Tacos.
Garcia-Martinez won the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary.
She said in the survey that she focuses on equity in education, advocates for the immigrant community and is running to bring community-driven solutions to schools and neighborhoods.
